# percall

> Pay-per-call JSON-RPC + agent data on early chains. Keyless: no API key, no account, no approval. Agents pay in USDC per call via the x402 HTTP-402 protocol. First pay-per-call endpoint on Arc (chainId 5042, Circle's stablecoin chain, USDC = native gas).

## What it is

`https://api.percall.io` is a public JSON-RPC gateway. An unauthenticated request returns HTTP 402 with a payment challenge; the client signs a USDC `transferWithAuthorization` (EIP-3009, gasless for the payer) and retries; the call executes and payment settles on Arc within seconds. No API keys, no project approval, no rate-limit account.

- Base URL: `https://api.percall.io`
- RPC endpoint: `POST /arc/` (JSON-RPC 2.0, Arc mainnet, chainId 5042 / hex 0x13b2)
- Health: `GET /health` (no auth)
- Stats: `GET /stats` (no auth, live revenue counters)
- Prepaid top-up: `POST /topup` (see below)
- MCP server (for agent frameworks): https://github.com/percallio/percall-mcp

## What the client needs

1. An EOA wallet with **USDC on Arc** (chainId 5042). The payer never pays gas — payment is an EIP-3009 authorization that percall settles; only the USDC balance matters.
2. Any HTTP client. No account, no key issuance.

## Pricing (per call, USDC, 6 decimals)

| Tier | Price | Methods |
|---|---|---|
| light | 0.002 (2000 units) | eth_blockNumber, eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionCount, most eth_get* |
| standard | 0.003 (3000 units) | eth_call, eth_getTransactionReceipt, everything else known |
| heavy | 0.005 (5000 units) | eth_getLogs, eth_getBlockByNumber, trace_*, debug_*, unknown methods |
| batch | 0.002–0.05 (per item) | JSON-RPC array body — each item priced by its own method, sum capped at 50,000 units |
| `/early` monitor | 0.01 (10,000 units) | monitoring snapshot: latest block + its txs; optional `address` + `window` (10–300s) = txs touching that address in the window |
| `/alerts` delta feed | 0.005 (5,000 units) | address USDC in/out flows over a window + live balance. Built for 30–60s polling: `?address=0x..&window=60`. Served from a rolling in-memory buffer (sub-second). |
| `/audit` token check | 0.02 (20,000 units) | token hygiene report: name/symbol/decimals/supply, owner + renounced, proxy/upgradeable, 1h volume, risk flags, verdict `pass`/`warn`/`fail`. `?address=0x<token>` |
| `/whales` flow ranking | 0.005 (5,000 units) | top 20 USDC flow addresses in a window (bridge/DEX/whale detection). `?window=3600`. Sub-second (rolling buffer). |
| `/deployments` new contracts | 0.01 (10,000 units) | fresh smart-contract deployments in a window — early token/contract discovery. `?window=3600`. |
| `/wallet-report` profile | 0.05 (50,000 units) | one-call address risk/flow profile: USDC balance + window in/out + top 5 counterparties (contract-checked) + risk flags. Replaces ~8 RPC round-trips. `?address=0x..&window=86400`. |
| `/token-report` full report | 0.05 (50,000 units) | everything in `/audit` plus top-10 recipient holders and flow concentration. `?address=0x<token>` |

Payment failures are machine-readable: a rejected `X-PAYMENT` returns HTTP 402 whose body carries a stable error code you can switch on to self-heal — `invalid_payment_format`, `invalid_payment_scheme`, `invalid_payment_payto`, `invalid_payment_amount`, `invalid_payment_expired`, `invalid_payment_early`, `invalid_payment_signature`, `invalid_payment_signer` (e.g. `expired` → re-sign with a fresh `validBefore`; `amount` → your value exceeded the quoted price; `signature`/`signer` → key mismatch).

**Weekly pack (recurring value):** `$5` = 5,000,000 units = 1,666 standard calls, 7-day TTL credit pool. Buy with one TWA: `POST /topup` with `"plan": "week"` and `value = 5000000`. Consumed before perpetual credits; stackable (extends expiry); zero on-chain ops per call.

## Free tier

50 free calls/day per wallet. Identify with header `X-From: 0x<wallet>` and send the RPC POST **without** `X-PAYMENT` while free quota remains — no on-chain payment at all. When quota runs out the server returns 402 (start paying or wait for UTC reset).

## How to pay (raw HTTP, x402 v2)

1. `POST https://api.percall.io/arc/` with your JSON-RPC body, no payment headers.
2. Receive `402 Payment Required`. The full payment payload is in the **`Payment-Required` response header** (base64-encoded JSON, x402Version 2) — also mirrored in the JSON body for convenience. Take `accepts[0]`:
   - `amount`: price in USDC units (6 decimals); `maxAmountRequired` is the same (compat)
   - `payTo`: percall settlement wallet
   - `asset`: `0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000` (Arc USDC precompile)
   - `network`: `eip155:5042` (CAIP-2; echo it back unchanged)
   - bazaar extension (`extensions.bazaar`): human/agent service description + JSON schemas for input/output
3. Build the EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` (from = your wallet, to = payTo, value = amount, validAfter/validBefore, fresh random 32-byte nonce) and EIP-712 sign it with your Arc wallet:
   - domain: `{name: "USDC", version: "2", chainId: 5042, verifyingContract: 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000}`
   - type: `TransferWithAuthorization(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 validAfter,uint256 validBefore,bytes32 nonce)`
4. Retry the same POST with header:
   `X-PAYMENT: base64url({"x402Version":2,"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:5042","payload":{from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce,v,r,s}})`
   (`value` is a decimal string, `v` 27/28, `r`/`s` hex strings.)
5. `200` = result + settlement in flight (typically < 15s on-chain). The TWA is valid ~600s; if the server restarts mid-flight it resumes settlement after reboot.

`GET /early` (monitoring, 0.01 USDC) uses the identical dance; params via query (`?address=0x..&window=60`) or JSON body.

`GET /alerts?address=0x..&window=60` (0.005 USDC), `GET /whales?window=3600` (0.005), `GET /deployments?window=3600` (0.01), `GET /wallet-report?address=0x..` (0.05), `GET /audit?address=0x<token>` (0.02), and `GET /token-report?address=0x<token>` (0.05) also use the same x402 dance (or the free tier via `X-From`). All seven data/report endpoints accept a JSON POST body as well as query params. The two $0.05 report endpoints are the "one call replaces N round-trips" products: prefer them when you need an address or token profile instead of assembling it from raw calls.

## Prepaid credits (`POST /topup`) — one authorization instead of one tx per call

For steady usage, prepay once: same EIP-712 signature, but `to` = payTo and `value` = credit amount (1000..10,000,000 units = $0.01..$100), `validBefore` within 24h..7d, fresh random nonce. Then:

- `POST /topup` with body `{"x402Version":2,"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:5042","payload":{...TWA fields..., "v":"0x..","r":"0x..","s":"0x.."}}` → `200 {"ok":true,"credit_after":...}`. Add `"plan":"week"` and `value="5000000"` for the $5/7-day pack. Settles on-chain ~10s; if settlement fails the credit is auto-revoked.
- All subsequent RPC calls: send `X-From: 0x<wallet>` (no `X-PAYMENT`) — credits are debited per call, zero on-chain ops per call.
- When credits run out, the server returns 402 again (mix: credit calls + per-call payments is fine).

## MCP install (agents / Claude Desktop / Cursor)

Zero-dependency Python MCP server (stdlib only):

```
git clone https://github.com/percallio/percall-mcp
```

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "percall": {
      "command": "python3",
      "args": ["/path/to/percall_mcp.py"],
      "env": {
        "X402_MCP_KEY": "0x<wallet_private_key_on_Arc>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Tools: `chain_id` (free), `block_number`, `balance`, `eth_call`, `get_transaction_receipt`, `get_logs`, `rpc_raw`. Payment is handled automatically by the server (it reads the 402 challenge, signs, retries). The key signs payments only; it is never sent anywhere except in payment payloads.

## Errors

| Code | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 402 | unpaid / free quota used / TWA expired or invalid | sign the challenge in `accepts[0]` and retry (fresh TWA if `validBefore` passed) |
| 400 | topup validation failed (bad sig/nonce/window/amount) | check the `error` string |
| 502 | upstream RPC failure | retry (credits are auto-refunded on failure) |
| 503 | concurrency gate (`retryAfter: 5`) | back off and retry |

## Guarantees & model

- percall settles the payer's TWA itself (it is the x402 facilitator); payer gas cost is always 0.
- Per-wallet free quota: 50/day (UTC). Global free cap: 300/day.
- Settlement: Arc mainnet, tip 2 Gwei (USDC-gas), sub-second blocks; failed settlements refund/free-call accounting is automatic.
